environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with auto-assign public IP enabled. Task IAM role has s3:PutObject on the logging bucket. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile. The /tmp filesystem is a writable tmpfs shared across request handlers.

config.network: public subnet with IGW route, auto-assign public IP
config.container_runtime: ECS Fargate, root user, default seccomp
config.tmp_filesystem: tmpfs, world-writable, no noexec mount option
